content:
"Hold On" is a song by Canadian singer Justin Bieber. It was released on March 5, 2021, as part of his sixth studio album titled "Justice". The song was both written and produced by a team of collaborators including Bieber himself, alongside producers Watt (Andrew Watt), Louis Bell, and Jon Bellion, as well as other contributors.

The track showcases a mix of pop and rock elements with a strong melodic line and features emotive lyrics about support, love, and resilience. The theme revolves around the necessity of holding on through difficult times and being there for each other, reflecting a message of hope and perseverance.

Upon its release, "Hold On" received positive reviews from music critics, who praised its catchy melody and heartfelt lyrics. Its commercial performance was also notable; the song charted in several countries and gained significant streaming and radio play.

The music video for "Hold On" complements the song's themes, portraying a narrative that features Justin Bieber engaging in a series of dramatic events to support a loved one in need. The storytelling in the video highlights the lengths one might go to for the sake of loved ones, aligning well with the song’s lyrical message.

"Hold On" forms part of Bieber’s broader musical efforts in "Justice" which features themes around love, justice, and humanity. His work on this album reflects his maturity as an artist and has been part of his ongoing evolution in the music industry.
